item.title: Pitch Black Appoints Alexandra Daunt Watney as President of Rising Sun Pictures - RSP
item.description: Pitch Black, the parent company of leading visual effects studios FOLKS, Rising Sun Pictures (RSP), and El Ranchito is proud to announce the appointment of Alexandra Daunt Watney as the new President of Rising Sun Pictures.
